trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game. There is no shortcut: finish the story, work through the 100% completion checklist, then clean up the stranger strands and the remaining activities. Follow the roadmap in this guide in order.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when you finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene, so do not worry if it arrives a little late. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when you finish Chapter 2. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when you finish Chapter 3. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when you finish Chapter 4. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when you finish the final mission. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the 100% Completion checklist, which unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts. The checklist is forgiving — it is closer to 60% true completion — and nothing toward it is missable, so everything can be done after the story in free-roam. Most of it comes from doing the other trophies: scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, complete 70 of 80 challenges, finish 300 stunts, and do the robberies and collectibles. Do optional missions as they appear (you need any 100) and scan or study things as you go.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. There are four kinds: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps — you can mix them to reach 250. Under the Bridges are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and see found and completed stunts on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. For the 100% checklist you need 300 stunts, so this comes naturally on the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, Playing a Video Game, winning a Car Race / Race Challenge / Top Fun Drone Race, and performing a Stunt. You can see the types under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You are introduced to most of them through the story, and the rest get marked when you unfog the map (filter the map for Activities, the blue dumbbell icon). You will do one of each almost automatically while working on the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across 12 range locations. The medals are not too hard — take your time and learn each range's layout. Shooting Range practice also raises your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations, 42 drone races in total. You only need one win per location, not every race. Learn each course's line and keep your drone steady through the gates.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, from the 40 unique race locations. Any 20 will do — pick the courses and vehicles you are most comfortable with and work through them after the story.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), your friend Cal will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are 4 (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable at the TV in your home by interacting with the controllers — you can already do this during Chapter 1. The fourth is found at arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever game you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline. It is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3 — at some point while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, which marks the questline on the map in Belville. Complete her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van) and Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse). All quests are still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It gets marked automatically in Chapter 1 — a while after the main mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he will call you, then he is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He offers treasure-diving quests at shipwrecks: he marks purple treasure chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasures (use the metal detector to dig them up from the ocean floor) and bring them back. In total he wants you to clear 7 shipwrecks. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapter 2–3, so he is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (Join Billy on a Job), Mall Rats (Join Billy on a Job), The Impaler (Steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job). All his quests are still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count: Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile, deliveries) are confirmed to count, with more strangers yet to be discovered. Note that many optional questlines do NOT count as strangers for this trophy — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are excluded. You can find the strangers after the story in free-roam, and you can see how many you completed via the trophy tracker in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List. It gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — during that mission you unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Randy then gives you a list of 16 sports cars he wants. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the wishlist, then drive it back to his garage (green RK icon in the west of Vice City). He marks some cars for you automatically; you can also steal them anywhere off the street. Delivering one in good condition pays more. This can still be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline. It gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. You will see purple markers for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go to the labs and destroy them (quest Take Out Kitty Litter). After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. All of this is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 meditations at the same location. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. You cannot do the final meditation until you unlock playing both characters together (after Chapter 2: Coffee Break). For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18 meditations.
trophies.missable_note: kemungkinan missable (inferensi) — sumber: PowerPyx. Ada 1 meditasi yang hanya bisa dilakukan selama Chapter 1 di rumah Jason: setelah misi utama Down to Earth, bicaralah dengan Lucia di dapur pada pagi hari; ia akan berkata ia akan bermeditasi, lalu pergi ke balkon. Ikuti ia dan pilih Accept. Meditasi ini menambah penghitung +1 di menu Progress, tetapi tidak ditandai sebagai Meditation Spot seperti yang lain, jadi belum jelas apakah ia wajib untuk trofi ini atau tidak. Lakukan saat masih di Chapter 1 untuk aman.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline. It gets marked automatically at some point after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break — while playing as Jason you will get a text message from Bret Vogel that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive the message). The questline is exclusive to Jason and is still available after the story. Do Bret's first quest; afterward he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map, and you hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can retrieve from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. Track these under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, and you need all 15 for the 100% checklist, so this should come naturally. Which animal exactly unlocks this trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card set locations to find around Leonida. Cards are a collectible type — pick them up as you explore and check your progress in the collections menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold up on the D-pad, then R1 to scan). WAiNK scans are objects in the environment — 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher Tags. There are more than 100 in total, so it does not matter which 100 you scan. Scan things as you explore and this comes naturally.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 available challenges. For the 100% checklist you need any 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically along the way. You can view and track the challenges under Progress > Challenges. Many of them complete naturally while working on the other trophies — save this for one of your last trophies, then pick the easiest and quickest challenges you have remaining.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The earliest you can do this is after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you unlock free-roam together as Jason and Lucia. Call your partner (hold right on the D-pad and press Triangle). Getting a 4-star wanted level is easy — cause carnage until you reach 4 stars. Then escape with a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic to get out of the search area; if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it goes away. An easy method is to drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County), where the cops have trouble following you on the train tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy unlocks after you drive out of the red heat wanted zone. You will also get this automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing the large bank vaults always triggers a 4-star wanted level.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons on the map) while being chased by police the whole time — you want to keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs (bought at Ammu-Nation) and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. Call your partner (hold right on the D-pad and press Triangle), then loot 3 shops in a row. If it does not unlock after the 3rd shop, hit a 4th shop and keep going. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop. A good place is the 3 Jewelry Stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — rob a couple of items in each store and ideally go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). The easiest way is the WAiNK app on your phone (hold up on the D-pad to use it instantly) — look at vehicles and hold R1 to scan them. Just stand at a busy road and scan the vehicles passing by; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. You need to scan 200 of the base model vehicles for the 100% checklist, so this comes automatically. Check your discovered vehicles via Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm — it slows time and highlights vulnerable spots on enemies, and drains the purple focus bar in the top left corner below your health and stamina. You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in one use, but Combat Focus only lasts a few seconds. First, buff your focus by consuming food/drinks or washing your face/showering at home, and consume Adrenaline to extend the time (hold L1, then press Triangle). Then line up 5 enemies (criminals at Gang Operations work well) and defeat them quickly without missing a shot. Wear body armor (bought at Ammu-Nation) so you can walk out of cover and get close. Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 — it is more accurate than pistols and SMGs and shoots full-auto. The trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. This gets easier as you progress and level up your Focus (4 levels; check under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus). You raise Focus by playing Shooting Range challenges, Golf, Pool, catching fish and doing headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the planes out on the airfield do not work. Inside the plane go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly far enough away from the airport until the trophy unlocks. The easiest plane is the one connected to departure terminals E3/E4: drive through one of the fences around the airfield and head straight to the plane, where stairs next to the boarding bridge lead directly into it. The unlock is a bit delayed — you must fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. You find them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island in the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or do the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, enter a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First, finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — this unlocks the Snap Gun to silently lockpick alarmed doors, and unlocks Jewelry Store Robberies (marked automatically in unfogged map areas with a green icon). Break into a jewelry store through the backdoor using the Snap Gun (the gadget stays in your inventory permanently; approaching a locked door gives you the prompt to kick it, which triggers the alarm, or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach). Enter the backroom, look for a note with the safe code, and use the code to loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First, finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it is marked automatically from story progress and is the introduction to bank vault robberies. You tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase with cash into the bank and they open the vault; go in quickly while the vault is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash yourself — bring your partner and hold right on the D-pad to hand off one bag. After this quest you can pay Yasmani (the fence unlocked in Chapter 3) for tips about security vans; if you have not done his previous quests yet, do those first (robbing 2 Payday Loans), then he sells the tips for $10,000. Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — use a fast motorcycle to cut through traffic, then switch to another vehicle to become unrecognizable. There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total: you need any 5 for this trophy, but all 8 for the 100% checklist, so it comes automatically. This is also the best way to make money in the endgame — up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies. Robbing the vault of a large bank automatically counts as robbing an armored truck: you tail the armored truck to the bank, the guard carries the cash to the vault, you quickly enter the vault to steal all the cash and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). You have to rob all 8 Large Bank Jobs for the 100% checklist, so this comes automatically. There is also a method to get it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block their path, plant a sticky bomb on their back door and blow it up. The trophy unlocks only after escaping the red heat radius. You can find sticky bombs in the back of Yasmani's shop after doing his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. This is best done with a plane: fly over all the areas with black fog on the map until the entire map becomes visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs and 39 Illegal Gang Operations. For this trophy you only need to complete 1 operation belonging to each gang, but for the 100% checklist you need all 39, so it comes automatically. Operations get marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are also marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of their operations you robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Diturunkan dari deskripsi resmi PlayStation; belum ada panduan komunitas yang terkonfirmasi. The official description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — so the method is to find a bar or cocktail spot overlooking Ocean Beach and order a drink there. No community guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet.

source.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophies (official list); PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a specific car from a specific vehicle showroom and drive it through the showroom's window. The car you need is the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window. The unlock is slightly delayed — it pops after you drive further away on the street. The trophy only unlocks from this blue Banshee specifically, not from any other car. It is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the Gang Operations in Port Gellhorn. Before going there, buy Sticky Bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to destroy the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which gets marked automatically during Chapter 2. Inside the bowling alley you must pick up the 3 key valuables: the Luxury watch in the office in the south-east (it has a golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway, which you blow up with Sticky Bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not immediately when picking up the third item. This trophy is not missable: if you do not rob all 3 items during the optional mission, you can wait until the robbery icon respawns (it takes a long time), then go there again and steal the remaining key valuables.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both characters, Jason and Lucia, at the same time. Check your strength level via Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (select a character) > scroll down to Strength (heart icon). You can only start doing this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Increase strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club. Always go together with both characters (hold right on the D-pad and press Triangle to call your partner): while you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training, so you make double the progress. Filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon). There are lots of them all over Vice City. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. You can view how many of 500 you have done by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. It is recommended to turn on Criminal Profile notifications in the UI settings (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — whenever you do something that affects your reputation, you will see a little demon face on the right side of the screen. The profiles are Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians or driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (a permanent status if you keep using excessive violence — avoid it, because cops become more aggressive). There is a good chance you get this naturally while working on all the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so do not worry about it. Should you still not have it when you are done with everything else, you can farm it quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Diturunkan dari deskripsi resmi PlayStation; belum ada panduan komunitas yang terkonfirmasi. The official description reads 'Second time's the charm.' — no community guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet; it is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but that is unconfirmed. Do not chase this one early; check a community guide once one is published.

trophies.guide: Diturunkan dari deskripsi resmi PlayStation; belum ada panduan komunitas yang terkonfirmasi. The official description reads 'What the hell just happened?' — no community guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet; it is believed to be from a UFO questline, but that is unconfirmed. Do not chase this one early; check a community guide once one is published.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Diturunkan dari deskripsi resmi PlayStation; belum ada panduan komunitas yang terkonfirmasi. The official description reads 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.' — no community guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet; it is believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but that is unconfirmed. Do not chase this one early; check a community guide once one is published.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First, finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — this unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer to launder marked bills. Then rob Banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). You need to deliver a total of $250,000 in marked bills to a Fence; it counts across all robberies, you do not need to bring $250,000 at once. This comes naturally while you do all the robberies for the 100% checklist. The Bank Vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery within a few minutes, but those are only unlocked after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. Buying guns, car mods and tattoos is the fastest method, since these are the most expensive. There are 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations (gun stores), 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear Stores, 18 Hair & Beauty Salons, 11 Tattoo Studios and 15 Electronics Stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 purchasable garages and 4 story-related garages — for this trophy you only need the 8 purchasable ones. They cost a total of $160,000. Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). You receive a notification that a new app has been installed on your phone, called Vice City Real Estate, and you buy the garages through the phone app. A quick way to make money is to do robberies, especially later in Chapters 3–4 when you unlock higher-value robberies.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location wherever you are. To register 10 vehicles you must buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds 1 or more parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and Register. You unlock Moses from the same mission that unlocks the Scooter Bros app. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering vehicles costs money — if you want to keep expenses low, go for cheap low-end cars and bikes.
